svg.title: Practice & learning. React exercises (Learning log): Router, Context API, Redux Toolkit and a localStorage todo app. Context API blog (Complete): Paginated blog reader built on React Context. Random GIF generator (Complete): Random and tag-based GIFs from the Giphy API via a custom hook. RazorPay UI clone (Complete): Static landing-page clone in HTML and Tailwind CSS. Password generator (Complete): Length, character-set and strength options with copy to clipboard. Weather app (Almost done): City weather lookup with the OpenWeather API. Music course landing page (Incomplete): Hero and featured-courses sections in Next.js 14. CSS practice (Practice): Image gallery, parallax page and button hover effects.
